name: tdp-workspace
description: TDP Monorepo workspace for NLE Frontend and Backend

scripts.build: npm --prefix NLE-backend run build && npm --prefix NLE-frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix NLE-backend run typecheck && npm --prefix NLE-frontend run type-check
scripts.push: git -C NLE-frontend push origin main && git -C NLE-backend push origin main
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix NLE-backend install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix NLE-frontend install
